facets.description: Admin::GroupsController#add_members (line 66) requires group_id, which the routes do not supply.
Admin::GroupsController#remove_member (line 85) requires group_id, which the routes do not supply.
config/routes.rb (lines 49–50) defines /admin/groups/members paths without a group identifier, so the client's /admin/groups/:id/members.json URLs do not match.
